name: Doki Doki Literature Club: Another Moment With You
source:
Another Moment With You is an episodic, good ol’ fashioned visual novel experience, lacking any of the meta weirdness from vanilla DDLC. Each episode will force you to journey through the inner demons plaguing the four girls, allowing you to view things from their perspectives and step into their shoes.

Focusing purely on the design of the overarching story, Another Moment With You is a touching and emotional experience through-and-through that will have you hooked from the get-go.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191226195814/http://ddlcmods.com/another-moment-with-you/] DDLCMods[/url]]
